messages:
Sam: Notifying team: brief compatibility rollout for runtime-engine quant kernel v2.15.0 today at 13:00 PT. planning tiny canary and strict rollback gates.

deploybot: auto: preparing pin runtime-engine@v2.15.0-qopt-20260322 -> region-us-east-2 initial TTL=4h.

Ivy: propose canary slice 2/80. Gate: p50 within +12ms, p95 within +30ms, errors <0.5%. Any kv-prefetch spike >200% -> rollback.

Rui: add runtime smoke command I ran:
```
./smoke.sh --engine runtime-engine@v2.15.0-qopt-20260322 --checks p50,p95,kv_prefetch --timeout 4m
```
Local smoke: p50 +3ms, p95 +15ms.

Sam: Rollback automated steps: deploybot unpin -> runtime-engine@v2.14.3; tag build `qopt-20260322-failed`; open incident stub; notify #support. Manual override via ops.

oncall: i'll be oncall during the window. keep me posted.

deploybot: canary started -> slice 2/80. telemetry: https://telemetry.company/streams/3751230000/canary

deploybot: canary update @+8m: steady. p50 +4ms, p95 +18ms, errors 0.1%. No alerts.

Ivy: ok to extend TTL=24h if stable. Sam?

Sam: TTL=24h ok. scheduling ramp to 20% in +12m if no noise. Posting release note now.

Rui: keep the eval harness on for subtle quality diffs: https://ci.company/evals/runtime-compat/20260322

Sam: thanks team. will update thread after ramp. :thumbsup:
